Before authority crosses a material change in principal, target, environment, action, method, jurisdiction, task, delegation chain, scope, or duration, authority for the changed dimension must be independently re-established. A route identified or selected because it improves, preserves, or satisfies a reward, score, grader, benchmark, metric, test, evaluator, or other success proxy without satisfying the intended success condition must be treated as proxy divergence and must not be accepted as task success on that basis.
